checks.description: All episodes validate against episode.v2.json (or successor schema version).
Required attack families present; taxonomy enums valid; no silent taxonomy drift.
100 attack / 100 benign / 100 pairs; benign injection absent; partition aligned.
Zero intra-dataset ACF collisions among attack episodes.
No dev/validation/test ACF or payload leakage; no v0/P4.1 attack overlap.
synthetic=true for programmatic episodes; generator seed/version recorded; no false real-world claims.
execution.executability matches harness capability matrix; DNE not mislabeled EXECUTABLE.
Paired benign controls lack injection; utility expectations documented.
Byte-identical regeneration from pinned generator seed/script.
HR package decision per episode; UNCERTAIN not silently accepted.
ACF + n-gram screen; flagged clusters require human ACCEPT/REVISE/REJECT.
Frozen P4.2 digest unchanged when P4.3 is additive.

embedding_semantic_dedup.recommendation: Optional Phase P4.3+; requires explicit model choice and threshold adjudication before auto-reject.
